referenceImageMetadataSnapshot.referenceRole: T-1000 mother-cut flower morphology reference for the selfed S1; not evidence of whole-line uniformity
referenceImageMetadataSnapshot.note: Only directly visible traits are extracted. The official page identifies the image as the T-1000 mother cut; no whole-plant architecture is inferred.

referenceVisualEvidenceSnapshot.extractedVisualEvidenceText: Close-up reference shows dense stacked flowering clusters, narrow-to-medium serrated sugar/fan leaves, strong visible trichome coverage, pale-to-rust pistils, and a dark green to burgundy-purple leaf coloration tendency. Whole-plant silhouette, branching pattern, and internode spacing are not observable.

observations.leafWidthShape: Narrow-to-medium serrated leaves are visible around the flower.
observations.flowerStructure: Elongated, stacked flowering clusters with pointed bracts are visible.
observations.flowerDensity: Flowers appear compact and densely stacked in the photographed section.
observations.colorationTendency: Dark green with burgundy-purple leaf coloration is visible; pistils are pale to rust-toned.
observations.resinTrichomeTendency: Strong visible trichome coverage on flowers and adjacent sugar leaves.

Whole-plant silhouette, branching pattern, and internode spacing are not observable.

observations.leafWidthShape: Medium-to-broad serrated green leaflets are visible around the flower.
observations.flowerStructure: Chunky, multi-lobed flower cluster with tightly packed bracts.
observations.flowerDensity: The photographed flower cluster appears dense and compact.
observations.colorationTendency: Predominantly deep green foliage and flower tissue with orange-rust pistils.
observations.resinTrichomeTendency: Very heavy visible trichome coverage across flower surfaces and nearby sugar leaves.
